obligations.source_text: The complete outfit topology, neckline, both shoulders and sleeves, waist and closure or crotch and inseam region, legs, and hems must remain fully visible and readable in one vertical full-body frame.

bindings.continuous_neckline_phrase: the neckline remains continuous across the upper torso above both openings
bindings.paired_cutouts_phrase: two bounded shoulder-top cutouts are visible, one on each side
bindings.attached_sleeves_phrase: both sleeves remain attached below the cutouts and continue down the upper arms
bindings.finished_edges_phrase: finished seams bound every cutout edge, while fabric bridges connect neckline, bodice, and sleeves
bindings.off_shoulder_confound_phrase: an off-shoulder neckline does not substitute for bounded windows; the design reads as attached sleeves around two finished shoulder windows
